parent.title: A weekend in Bray — booking the dinner, walking to it, filling the days

siblings.title: Michelin 2 and 3-star restaurants in Bray
siblings.summary: Bray's 2/3-star Michelin map for 2026: two three-star icons (Waterside Inn, Fat Duck), no two-star — when to pick which, and what nearby.

siblings.title: Activities and day-trips within 30 km of Bray
siblings.summary: What to do beyond Bray — Windsor, riverside towns, stately homes, outdoor adventures, family attractions and the Berkshire events calendar within a 30 km radius.

siblings.title: IT conferences and tech events within 30 km of Bray
siblings.summary: Reading is the tech-event centre of gravity; free monthly meetups dominate the calendar, with DigiMarCon at Heathrow T5 and ECMWF's ML seminar the only multi-day conferences in radius.

sources.title: Mapcarta — Waterside Inn ↔ Fat Duck
sources.claim: Waterside Inn sits 192 m (630 ft) northeast of The Fat Duck on Bray's High Street.

sources.title: My-Towns — Bray street map
sources.claim: Street map confirming the in-village positions of Bray's starred restaurants.

sources.title: Tripadvisor — hotels nearest The Fat Duck
sources.claim: Ranked distances from Fat Duck: Bray Cottages 0.0 mi, Waterside Inn 0.1 mi, Monkey Island 0.7 mi, Thames Riviera 1.1 mi, Travelodge 1.2 mi, Premier Inn 1.3 mi.

sources.title: Visit Windsor — Bray Cottages
sources.claim: Bray Cottages comprises 7 properties with capacities from 2 to 6 guests across Yew Tree, Christmas, Dormer, Tiggers, Lavender House and Bray House.

sources.title: A Lady in London — 24 hours in Bray
sources.claim: Booking a room at The Waterside Inn guarantees guests a table for dinner.

sources.title: Waterside Inn — Accommodation
sources.claim: 11 guest rooms across Classic, Superior, Deluxe and Suite categories, in the main building or adjacent cottages.

sources.title: Boarding Group — Monkey Island Estate review
sources.claim: Footbridge-only access on a private Thames island, within walking distance of Bray's restaurants. Maidenhead is ~25 min by Elizabeth line from London.

sources.title: Luxury-Hotels — Monkey Island rates
sources.claim: Monkey Island Estate room rates start from approximately £275 per night for a Temple Room.

sources.title: Bray Cottages — the village
sources.claim: Bray's conservation area can be walked around in about an hour.

sources.title: Michelin Guide — Hind's Head
sources.claim: Hind's Head is a one-Michelin-starred pub on High Street, Bray, SL6 2AB.

sources.title: Michelin Guide — Waterside Inn
sources.claim: Waterside Inn is a three-Michelin-starred restaurant at Ferry Road, Bray, SL6 2AT.

sources.title: Muddy Stilettos — Bray Cottages
sources.claim: Bray Cottages described as opposite the Waterside Inn's front door and a short walk to the other Bray eateries.

sources.title: Bray Cottages — Rates
sources.claim: Christmas Cottage £425/night, Tiggers Cottage £495 (1 BR) / £695 (2 BR); whole-cottage exclusivity plus organic breakfast hamper.

sources.title: Tripadvisor — Waterside Inn reviews
sources.claim: 2025-2026 reviewers note rooms feel dated and noise carries from the dining room below; bills around £765 cited as good value.

sources.title: Waterside Inn — Suites
sources.claim: Mallards apartment £810/night inclusive of French continental breakfast (1 Oct 2025 – end Apr 2026).

sources.title: Monkey Island Estate — Accommodation
sources.claim: Four room categories (Barn, Temple, Temple Terrace, Wedgewood Suite) across 41 rooms, on a private island via footbridge from Old Mill Lane, SL6 2EE.

sources.title: Visit Windsor — Thames Riviera
sources.claim: Thames Riviera Hotel sits on Maidenhead Bridge with riverside walks but is on the Maidenhead side relative to Bray.

sources.title: Tripadvisor — Oakley Court ↔ Fat Duck
sources.claim: Oakley Court is approximately 2.2 miles from The Fat Duck — about a 10-minute taxi, not practical walking distance.
